## Operator directive (2026-09-04, verbatim)

> "V2 is the repo for the development of the science field machine epistemic, so it will be research space, of course we will study more theories and algorithms about the machine epistemic when we develop the ocm, you should check the work division in the ocm repo!"

Earlier the same evening: "the ocm work is now moved to the orion ocm repo, so there should be no more ocm work left in orion-v2 repo" / "remove ocm lane from orion v2 and focus on the ocm development in the new repo" / "finish all the paper related tasks in orion v2, make sure they are top tier journal ready".

`SzeChunYiu/ORION-OCM` #1 (grand plan) and its migration provenance treat ORION-V2 as *source lineage* only and state no division. This issue is the division.

## The division

| | **ORION-V2 — machine-epistemics science** | **ORION-OCM — the machine** |
|---|---|---|
| owns | theories, theorems + proofs, algorithms as registered studies, exact finite calibrations, negatives and their revivals, parent subtraction, the failure taxonomy, freeze/seed-commitment discipline, the papers' evidence and release gates | the runnable knowledge-space machine: runtime modules, domains, run receipts, milestones M0–M12, CI for the machine |
| canonical for | `theory/`, `design/` (structures · maths · dynamics · algorithms · mechanics · architecture), exact science checkers (`ocm_lane*_exact.py`, `ocm_warrant*_exact.py`, `rcl_checks_*`), ledgers, science receipts | `reference/kso_*` runtime, `domains/`, `results/KSO_*` run receipts, demos, `ocm chat` |
| absorbs from the other | machine results enter V2 as *evidence* for theory (receipt + SHA), never as authority | V2 theory/algorithms enter OCM as code with a parity test against the V2 study (the absorption ledger, `design/07_ABSORPTION.md`) |
| a new question found while building | is filed as a V2 research ticket (theory/algorithm study, frozen, with a strongest-parent comparator) — never solved ad hoc inside the machine | is implemented only after the V2 study returns a terminal; `PARENT_SUFFICIENT` is a legitimate terminal |
| example | M2's navigation misses (EXTRACT surprise baseline at small seed size) → a V2 study of reaction-surprise baselines vs parents | the winning baseline lands in OCM with the parameter study citing the V2 row |

Rules that follow: no wholesale deletion of `research/orion-machine` in V2 — only the runtime pieces (which are canonical in ORION-OCM) become pointers after byte-identity is verified on ORION-OCM main; theory, design and science checkers stay and keep evolving here. The OCM lane works only in ORION-OCM; V2 gets a machine-epistemics research lane. Papers remain V2/ORION-paper outputs of this science. `NO NOVELTY OR BREAKTHROUGH CLAIM` in either repo.

# Machine Epistemics — field completion programme (batches 8+)

Operator direction (2026-09-05): finish the machine-epistemics foundation and all related extensions so it forms a complete field of science with theories and findings.

State: MEG-01…35 closed or exactly bounded (batches 1–7; atlas open list empty); Foundation V1, Field Dynamics V1 (Ξ state, seven transition families, twelve laws) and Frontier F1/F2/F6 integrated (#351); FDX-01…16 open on `research/machine-epistemics-theory/field_dynamics_v1/FRONTIER.md`.

## Deliverable
A field map `research/machine-epistemics-theory/FIELD_MAP_V1.md` that lists every theorem, law, bound and impossibility of the field with its status (PROVED / PARENT_OWNED / EXACTLY_BOUNDED_IMPOSSIBILITY / CONJECTURE / OPEN), its parent, its checker and the OCM obligation it induces — and a sequence of one-day batches that drives FDX-01…16 to those statuses with exact checkers, hostiles and no-alarm controls, in the batch 1–7 format.

## Batches (each: theorems → proofs on finite fixtures → exact checker → hostiles → status → consequences for the OCM build)
- **Batch 8** FDX-01 open-system closure, FDX-02 controlled viability (typed residual over the viability kernel or PARENT_SUFFICIENT), FDX-03 information/interface conservation (beyond version-space counting), FDX-05 reversible vs irreversible transitions.
- **Batch 9** FDX-08 stochastic warrant dynamics, FDX-11 epistemic bifurcation/obstruction, FDX-13 self-model calibration and reflexive dependence, FDX-15 parent-product equivalence / residual theorem.
- **Batch 10** FDX-06 distributed machine epistemics, FDX-07 epistemic games (parent-heavy; attack as such), FDX-14 whole-system lower bounds.
- **Batch 11** FDX-09 infinite structured lifecycle learning (the SHRG/CCG construction frontier, G9 bound), FDX-10 endogenous representation discovery (counting search information), FDX-12 safe incremental language commitment (the N2 realiser's theorem).
- **Batch 12** FDX-16 mechanized core semantics: the KnowledgeSpace semantics (warrant intervals, ⊕/⊗, reopening cone, authority meet) in Lean 4 with the OCM exact checkers as the oracle; CANNOT_CHECK until the Lean route is pinned.
- **Batch 13** the field map itself: consolidation, cross-references, the OCM obligation registry KS-T118+ derived from every row, and the list of exactly bounded impossibilities that closes the field's first version.

## Rules
Assimilation-first (parents named; PARENT_OWNED is a status, not a failure); no novelty claims; every item carries an exact checker verified on billy-old; consequences for the OCM build are read-only observations that ORION-OCM applies through its intake protocol.

# Machine Epistemics language-acquisition theory lane

Application trigger: `SzeChunYiu/ORION-OCM#52`  
Cross-domain scaling: `SzeChunYiu/ORION-OCM#50` and #358  
Science ↔ machine division: #304

## Central question

What is the minimal language-general computational substrate from which an epistemically governed machine can acquire executable communication competence, and under what conditions can accumulated linguistic structure reduce the marginal cost of learning later language families?

The application target is:

```text
minimal linguistic substrate
→ learned speaker/listener
→ better language learner
```

The theory must distinguish genuinely constitutional primitives from English competence smuggled into the substrate.

## T1 — minimal language substrate

Define a substrate that may include identity, evidence, warrant, dependency, persistence, executable operators, learning signals and minimal composition/representation primitives, while treating lexicon, morphology, grammar/constructions, word order, discourse/reference policies and realization conventions as learned objects when possible.

Seek necessity/impossibility results: which primitives cannot be removed without making the acquisition problem undefined or unidentifiable?

## T2 — learned bidirectional communication objects

Formalize learned structures supporting expression→meaning and meaning→expression without assuming they are always symmetric. Characterize when one direction can reduce acquisition cost in the other and when separate evidence is required.

## T3 — compositional generalization

Define a reusable linguistic competence object strongly enough that held-out composition is distinguishable from trace memorization. Candidate obligations should cover novel lexical fillers, novel combinations of known constructions, recursive composition, and scoped exceptions.

## T4 — acquisition-cost law for language

For registered language families `L_1...L_m`, formalize conditions under which:

```text
C_acquire(L_j | K_t) < C_acquire(L_j | K_0)
```

because prior linguistic structure provides reusable representation, operators, constraints, search reduction, or verifier reuse.

The analysis must subtract persistent grammar/skill-library, case-based, neural continual-learning and other strongest parents with the same reusable information.

## T5 — language meta-learning

Distinguish:

```text
learning language competence
```

from

```text
learning a strategy that improves later language acquisition
```

Require a formal test that cannot be satisfied merely because later construction families are easier or because a persistent memory stores previous examples.

## T6 — language-general scope

Formalize scoped coexistence of different language systems (`L_English`, `L_Chinese`, artificial/SOV systems) within one machine. Determine what correspondence may safely transfer across languages (semantic structure, acquisition strategies, morphology abstractions, etc.) and what must remain language-scoped.

## T7 — correction and revocation of learned communication

Define local revision obligations for lexical senses, construction rules, discourse conventions and acquisition strategies: stale linguistic competence must disappear exactly where its support dies, while unrelated language competence remains intact.

## Parent subtraction and terminals

Every theorem/claim must name its strongest parent first. Valid terminals include:

```text
PROVED_LANGUAGE_ACQUISITION_LAW
PARENT_OWNED
BOOTSTRAP_PRIOR_NECESSARY
BOOTSTRAP_PRIOR_DOMINATES
NO_LANGUAGE_META_LEARNING_RESIDUAL
TRADEOFF_FRONTIER_ONLY
CONJECTURE
CANNOT_CHECK
```

The desired outcome is a precise theory of when learned communication and language meta-learning are possible—not a requirement that Machine Epistemics own every mechanism involved.
